entries.note: Removes dangling images and dangling build cache (no -a). Does not delete the Docker data directory.

entries.operator_action: Disk Cleanup, DirectX Shader Cache, or the NVIDIA shader-cache size setting
entries.note: No CLI is bundled. The registry does not invent a delete command for the shader cache.

entries.operator_action: Cursor in-app cache clearing and backups retention
entries.note: Cache clearing is an in-app action. This lane does not delete the Cursor configuration directory.
Retention is configuration, not a static prune command.
No cache command. The http cache re-downloads on the next apply.
entries.recheckTrigger: The chezmoi doctor reference page describes any write, fix, or state change.

entries.operator_action: pulumi plugin rm for one unused name and version shown by pulumi plugin ls
entries.note: The unused version is not known to the registry, so plugin rm is not run.
entries.recheckTrigger: Either Pulumi CLI reference page describes the command changing state, installing, or removing plugins.

entries.note: Clears the NuGet http-cache, global-packages, temp, and plugins-cache folders; the next restore re-downloads packages. Does not delete the directory by path.
entries.recheckTrigger: The dotnet nuget locals page changes the caches all covers or what --list or --clear does.
